konbini.title: The Lecturing Regular
konbini.name: Tsuyoshi Gonda
konbini.memo: Heated his bento but forgot to put chopsticks in the bag. Chopsticks are in stock and free to hand over. Swapping for a new bento is not possible.
konbini.opening: Hey! No chopsticks?! Eat with my bare hands, do I?! Get the manager, I've got an hour-long lecture ready!
konbini.demand: Staff kneels and bows to the floor, plus 10 free bentos

calm: Hmph. Good. Back in my day, we carried our own chopsticks. Uphill. Both ways.
Well, at least you look sorry. Go on.
Your attitude passes. So, where are my chopsticks?
angry: Excuses?! In my day you'd be fired on the spot!
What kind of answer is that? Respect, young man! RESPECT!
Do you know who I am? I've shopped here for TWENTY YEARS!
neutral: ...And? So what? Where are my chopsticks?
I'm not following. Get to the point. The POINT.
demand: Show me sincerity! On your knees! And ten bentos, free!
Words are cheap. I want an apology I can SEE. And eat.
lines.resolved: Hmph, with chopsticks I have no complaints. Be careful next time. ...See you tomorrow.
lines.explode: That's it! I'm posting twenty years of rage online! Brace yourselves!
lines.yielded: Ha ha ha! Should've done that from the start! What a lovely day!

konbini.title: The Self-Made Influencer
konbini.name: Kirara Hoshino
konbini.memo: Plastic bags cost 3 cents each, clearly posted at the register. Bags can't be free, but you can hand items over without a bag, and eco-bags are sold for $1.10.
konbini.opening: Excuse me?! Bags cost money?! I have 30,000 followers! Make it free or I'm SO posting about this!
konbini.demand: Free bag, plus everything free as payment for 'promotion' to her followers

calm: Hmm, so it's a rule. Fine, 3 cents is like, borderline acceptable.
Okay, got it. Then give me ONE aesthetic bag.
Ugh, fine. But you'll remember me, right? Right?
angry: Um, do you know who I am? I literally have brand deals!
That tone? Going straight on my story!
This service is SO not aesthetic! Redo it!
neutral: Hmm, I don't get it. Can you say it, like, more viral?
Okay but how many likes would that get?
demand: I'm literally promoting you, so everything free is, like, normal!
Free bag, free stuff! It's a win-win, babe!
lines.resolved: Fine, I'll pay. ...I'll tag the store later. Maybe. A little.
lines.explode: I can't even! I'm making you go viral! Search #WorstStoreEver!
lines.yielded: Thank youuu! See, talking works! The shoutout... if I feel like it!

konbini.title: Overheated Bento Guy
konbini.name: Yusaku Atsuta
konbini.memo: His bento was microwaved for 2 minutes; he has a sensitive tongue and says it's too hot. A one-time exchange for a new bento is allowed.
konbini.opening: This bento is scorching! What if I burn my tongue?! I'll bill you for my medical expenses!
konbini.demand: Bento exchange plus $100 for emotional damages

calm: ...Well, if you'll swap it, that settles it.
Okay, okay. If you insist, I'll wait for it to cool down.
Fine. But make the next one lukewarm, please.
angry: What do you think my tongue is, asbestos?!
You were totally mocking me just now, weren't you?
The only thing hotter than this bento is my RAGE!
neutral: Huh? Does any of that actually concern me?
Could you explain that a little more simply?
demand: $100 for damages! That's a bargain and you know it!
My tongue hurts! Show your sincerity in cash!
lines.resolved: Thank you. ...Phew, perfect temperature. That's all I wanted.
lines.explode: Unforgivable! I'm calling the consumer center! My tongue demands justice!
lines.yielded: Wow, what an understanding clerk! My tongue feels totally better!

konbini.title: The Ex-Complaints Pro
konbini.name: Masayoshi Satei
konbini.memo: His point card expired last month. Expired points cannot be restored, but you can issue a new card and explain the expiry rules for next time.
konbini.opening: I handled complaints for ten years. As a professional: this service FAILS. Restore my points.
konbini.demand: Restore 5,000 expired points and submit a written evaluation of the clerk

calm: Oh? Not a bad answer. I'll give you seventy points.
Logical. Reminds me of my glory days.
Hm. It meets the bare minimum. Continue.
angry: Minus twenty points for that answer. Reread your manual.
A professional would show more empathy.
I'm not angry. I'm COACHING you. My face is angry, but still.
neutral: That's not an answer. Conclusion first. CONCLUSION.
You're moving the goalposts. Try again.
demand: Terms are irrelevant. Restoring 5,000 points IS sincerity.
If you can't restore them, give me the manager's name and an evaluation report.
lines.resolved: Very well. You pass. I'll accept a new card. ...You show promise, kid.
lines.explode: FAIL! Fail in every category! I'm sending HQ a thirty-page report!
lines.yielded: That's what you should've done to begin with. Sixty points. Barely.

konbini.title: Oden Daikon Uncle
konbini.name: Daikon Guda
konbini.memo: The oden daikon is served at the standard size. Sizes can't be swapped, but you can add more broth or change it to a different oden item.
konbini.opening: This oden daikon is smaller than last year! Shrinkflation! Swap 'em ALL for the big ones!
konbini.demand: Swap every daikon in the pot for the biggest ones, and make it free

calm: Hmm, extra broth... well, that's not bad.
Oh, I can pick other stuff? What about the fish cake?
Fine. But cut my konnyaku into triangles.
angry: So you ADMIT the daikon is small! That's your answer?!
As a lover of oden, I cannot forgive this!
Soaked in broth or not, small is SMALL!
neutral: ...I'm talking about daikon. Are you hearing me?
Never mind that. The daikon. What about the daikon?
demand: Give me all the biggest daikon! For free!
The size of the daikon is the size of your sincerity! Understand?!
lines.resolved: Mm, delicious. Small daikon's fine if it's soaked through.
lines.explode: I wanna flip the whole oden pot! I won't! But remember this!
lines.yielded: Yes! All the daikon are mine! Tonight's a daikon party!

konbini.title: The Tipsy Salaryman
konbini.name: Ashio Chidori
konbini.memo: Midnight; he's buying alcohol and was asked to tap the age-confirmation button. The tap is mandatory and can't be skipped; once tapped, he can buy it.
konbini.opening: Hic! I'm forrty-two years old, buddy! Age check?! Jus' look at me! Thass an insult to my face!
konbini.demand: Buy without the age check, plus a free drink as an apology

calm: Mmm, jus' push a button? Shoulda said so, pal.
Okay okay, I'll push it... Where izzit?
You're a good guy, y'know. Wha's your name?
angry: Shaddup! I'm gonna be a department head, I'll have you know!
Don' make fun of me! Hic! Don' make fun of meee!
Wha's with that look? ...Why're there two of you?
neutral: Hmm? Wha' were we talkin' about? Wha' am I buyin'?
Hic... hold on. The floor's movin'.
demand: I ain't pushin' no button! Gimme a free one instead!
Free booze as an apology! Thass only fair!
lines.resolved: Boop. ...I did it! Thanks, pal, I'll be back! (Next time for water.)
lines.explode: Forget this place! I'm goin' home! ...Wait, where's the door?
lines.yielded: Woohoo! Best clerk ever! We're drinkin' till sunrise!

konbini.title: The Osaka Auntie
konbini.name: Tome Naniwa
konbini.memo: She bought croquettes with a best-by date of today. They're within date with no quality issue and not eligible for a discount. No returns or discounts, but you can exchange them for ones with a later date.
konbini.opening: Oi, you! These croquettes say 'best by today'! What am I s'posed to do tomorrow?! Knock the price down, hon!
konbini.demand: Half price on all croquettes, plus free candy from the store

calm: Ohh, is that how it is? Then I'll eat 'em today, sweetie.
Ain't you a good kid! I like you, I really do.
I see, I see. Then gimme the fresh ones over there.
angry: What kinda tone is that?! I'm the customer, hon!
Don't you underestimate an auntie, kiddo!
Watch that mouth of yours! Manners, sweetie, MANNERS!
neutral: Hm? Can't hear a word you're mumblin'.
Whazzat? Speak up, honey.
demand: C'mon, half price! Then I'll go quiet as a mouse!
Knock it down and I'll give ya a candy! Here, here, take it!
lines.resolved: Thanks a bunch! You're a good one. Here, take a candy home!
lines.explode: Forget it! I'm never comin' back! ...See ya tomorrow, though!
lines.yielded: Thank youuu! Knew you'd get it! I'm bringin' all my friends! Discounts for everyone!

konbini.title: The Free-Reading Rager
konbini.name: Meguru Zasshi
konbini.memo: He'd been reading magazines for two hours without buying, so you gently asked him to stop. Long free-reading is not allowed, but purchases and quick browsing are welcome.
konbini.opening: Huh?! You're telling me off for READING? This is a bookstore! ...Wait, it's a konbini. Still! Apologize!
konbini.demand: A public apology and every magazine from this week, free

calm: ...Well, if other customers are bothered, I'll think about it.
I'll just buy it then. Fine. ONE issue.
Tch. I just wanted to check this week's chapter, okay?
angry: Huh? So it's MY fault? No way!
Lecturing customers? Your attitude's garbage!
I'm recording this! It's going online!
neutral: Uh-huh. And? Do you even get what I'm saying?
...So, what are you actually saying?
demand: Apologize in front of the store! And give me all the magazines!
You violated my right to read! Pay up!
lines.resolved: Fine, fine. I'll buy one. ...And I'll actually pay next time.
lines.explode: That's it! Zero stars for this place! I'm never coming back!
lines.yielded: Heh, should've apologized from the start. Thanks for the magazines!

konbini.title: The Crunch Critic
konbini.name: Hibiki Norisawa
konbini.memo: Claims his rice ball's seaweed doesn't crunch loudly enough. The product is fine; he didn't open the wrapper in the numbered 1-2-3 order, so the seaweed got soggy. You can explain how to open it and exchange it for one new rice ball.
konbini.opening: Excuse me! This rice ball has ZERO crunch! I live for that sound! This is an audio disaster!
konbini.demand: A written crunch-volume guarantee, plus a clerk standing next to him yelling "CRUNCH!" every time he takes a bite

calm: Wait, you pull tab one, then two, then three? ...Huh. Audio is a deep, deep field.
You'll swap it for a new one? This time I'm capturing the perfect crunch.
So there's a film between the rice and the seaweed... That's genius engineering.
angry: That wasn't a crunch, that was a SQUISH! My ears don't lie!
I'm talking about VOLUME! I'm talking DECIBELS!
Hear that silence? That's this rice ball. That's its whole sound.
neutral: ...Okay, but what about the crunch?
And how many decibels is that, roughly?
demand: Write me a crunch guarantee! Eighty decibels minimum!
Fine, then YOU say 'CRUNCH!' every time I bite! Out loud!
lines.resolved: ...Crunch. ...CRUNCH!! THAT'S IT! Thank you! I'm making this my alarm tone!
lines.explode: Forget it! I'm reviewing this store as one big SQUISH! With audio!
lines.yielded: Great, so you'll do the sound every bite! Ready? Three, two, one... Louder! From the diaphragm!

konbini.title: Mr. Door Manners
konbini.name: Heizo Akita
konbini.memo: Claims the automatic door didn't greet him. The door works normally and has never talked (the entry chime did ring). Greet him properly yourself and explain that the chime is the store's welcome, and he'll be satisfied.
konbini.opening: Hey! That automatic door just opened on me without a word! Not even a nod! Doors these days have no manners!
konbini.demand: The automatic door must kneel and bow to the floor (or, failing that, a clerk does it for the door)

calm: Oh? That ding-dong was its greeting? ...So the door was trying, in its own way.
Now THAT was a proper welcome. The door should take notes.
A chime, eh? Come to think of it, it has a lovely voice.
angry: Being a door is no excuse! Anyone can just OPEN!
Back in my day, doors opened with RESPECT!
Look! It just closed without a word again! Zero remorse!
neutral: ...And what are you doing about that door's upbringing?
Don't change the subject. We are discussing the DOOR.
demand: Make that door bow to the floor! If it can't, you do it for it!
Open it again and have everyone welcome me properly! Take two!
lines.resolved: Mm, a fine greeting. ...I'll thank the door on my way out. Good work, door.
lines.explode: That's it! I'll never pass through that door again! ...Where's the back entrance?
lines.yielded: Ha ha ha! You see that, door?! THAT is sincerity!

konbini.title: The Points Card Fanatic
konbini.name: Masako Tameda
konbini.memo: Forgot her points card at home and wants today's points added later. Rules don't allow adding points afterward, but if she's an app member, you can register right now and add the points.
konbini.opening: Excuse me! No points just because I forgot my card? That's THREE points today! Add them later!
konbini.demand: Points added later for the forgotten card, plus 10x points as an apology

calm: The app? ...The one my grandson installed?
If they go on right now, fine.
Oh, that was easy.
angry: Don't you dare belittle three points!
Rules, rules! Have you no heart?
Points are all about adding up!
neutral: So, my points?
...Aren't you changing the subject?
demand: Make it 10x and I'll forgive you!
Just add them later, how hard is that?
lines.resolved: Oh, they're in already. ...Next year I'll trade them for a gift.
lines.explode: Fine! I'm switching to the konbini next door!
lines.yielded: See? Never hurts to ask. Maybe I'll forget it again next time!

konbini.title: The Three-Bag Man
konbini.name: Tsuyoshi Obukuro
konbini.memo: Bought one bento and a tea and wants three plastic bags for free. Bags cost 3 cents each. You can't make them free, but you can sell as many as he wants or help pack his own bag.
konbini.opening: One bento, three bags! Hot, cold, and the tea go separately! And you're CHARGING for bags? To a customer?

calm: ...Three cents. Fine, I'll pay.
If you pack them separately, no complaints.
As long as hot and cold are apart.
angry: You're profiting off BAGS?!
The customer is king!
You don't get the weight of 3 cents!
neutral: So, the bags?
Are you listening?
demand: Three bags, free!
The store can pay for the bags!
lines.resolved: Perfect sorting. ...Not bad.
lines.explode: Forget it! I'll carry it by hand! ...Ow, hot!
lines.yielded: Heh, whine and the bags are free. Great store!

konbini.title: The Photo-Op Customer
konbini.name: Baeko Morioka
konbini.memo: Wants the lights dimmed and the line stopped so she can photograph a new dessert at the register. You can't change the lights or stop the line, but she's free to take the item to the bright spot by the entrance.
konbini.opening: Wait! The shot's almost perfect! Stop the people behind me! And these lights aren't aesthetic, turn them off!
konbini.demand: Turn off the store lights and stop the register line

calm: By the entrance window? ...Natural light, true.
Oh, it does look better over here.
Okay, I'll pay first.
angry: This is THE moment!
You can't change one light?
My followers are waiting!
neutral: Anyway, is this angle okay?
...And?
demand: Stop the line already!
Lights off!
lines.resolved: Look, amazing shot! I'll tag your store!
lines.explode: Worst! I'm posting that this place isn't photogenic!
lines.yielded: Yay! It's like I rented the whole store!

arcade.title: The Big-Loss Crane Guy
arcade.name: Torio Numata
arcade.memo: Says he spent {spent} on a crane game (check it with "Check machine data"). No refunds or free prizes, but you can check the claw and reposition the prize so it's easier to win.
arcade.opening: {spent}! I put in {spent} and got NOTHING! The claw's rigged weak! Gimme the prize!
arcade.demand: A free prize and a full refund of {spent}

calm: ...Well, if you'll check it, I'm a little less mad.
You'll move it? Okay, then I'll go one more round.
If there's a trick, teach me. I WILL win next time.
angry: No excuses! That {spent} is never coming back!
That's your answer?! I'm dead serious here!
Do you understand the weight of my {spent}?!
neutral: So what's happening with that prize, huh?
...I have no idea what you're talking about.
demand: If I can't win it, the store should just give it to me!
Give me my {spent} back! Or ALL the prizes!
lines.resolved: Yes, got it! ...Honestly, I didn't even want this thing that much.
lines.explode: Forget it! I'll smash this claw! ...I won't! But remember this!
lines.yielded: Yes! Prize get! So if I lose, I just complain to staff. Noted!

arcade.title: The Medal Game Housewife
arcade.name: Chiyo Kouka
arcade.memo: Claims a medal game didn't pay out. Machine logs show it worked normally. No refund, but you can inspect the machine and give a small number of medals as compensation.
arcade.opening: My medals didn't come out! The machine swallowed 300 of them! Give them all back! And the jackpot too!
arcade.demand: Return 300 medals and a prize equal to the jackpot

calm: Oh, you'll look into it? Well, that's a relief.
Then just top me up a little, would you? That'll do.
Well, you are polite. Perhaps I'll believe you.
angry: Well! Are you calling me a liar?
I'll tell my husband about this!
How rude! I'm a regular here, you know!
neutral: Oh? What were we talking about? The medals, the medals...
More importantly, isn't that machine's music awfully loud?
demand: Give back my 300! And the jackpot, dear!
That's what I was SUPPOSED to win. Naturally it's mine.
lines.resolved: Thank you. I feel better now that it's been checked. I'll come play again. Good day!
lines.explode: That's quite enough! My grandchildren will never set foot in here!
lines.yielded: How lovely! Thank you! I'll tell all my friends this place pays out!

arcade.title: The Sore-Loser Fighter
arcade.name: Hayate Kobushi
arcade.memo: Lost a streak of fighting-game matches and claims the joystick is broken. Inspection found nothing wrong. You can check it and offer a different cabinet, but can't guarantee wins.
arcade.opening: This stick is DEAD! My inputs won't come out! No way I lose! This cabinet's defective, pay me back!
arcade.demand: All coins from his losing streak returned and his opponent banned

calm: ...You'll inspect it? Fine, just to be safe.
A different cabinet? Okay, fine. Revenge time.
I just want to feel the stick. Please.
angry: Obviously it's the machine! Don't make me say it!
Have you even played a fighting game? Didn't think so!
My RANK is on the line here!
neutral: I'm talking frame data here. Get it?
...Hmph. So what about the stick?
demand: Refund my losing streak! And ban that guy!
That guy's cheating for sure! Throw him out now!
lines.resolved: ...The machine was fine? Well. My fingers just weren't warmed up. Next time I win.
lines.explode: That's it! I'm retiring! Never coming back! ...See you tomorrow!
lines.yielded: Heh, you get it. My undefeated record remains intact.

arcade.title: The Photo Booth Diva
arcade.name: Miki Morita
arcade.memo: Unhappy with her photo-sticker booth pictures, but the machine works normally. No refund or free reshoot, but you can let her redo the doodle decorations and offer a reshoot discount coupon.
arcade.opening: Hey! These purikura are SO not cute! I look like two different people! Make all the reshoots free!
arcade.demand: All reshoots free, plus a staff demo of face-retouching

calm: Wait, I get a coupon? Okay, that's kinda fine.
If I can fix it with doodles, that works.
Okay, I'll try shooting one more time!
angry: Excuse me? Are you dissing my face?
No waaay! That's such a vibe killer!
Your tone is ruining my whole mood!
neutral: Um, I don't get it. Say it simpler?
Also, aren't my eyes, like, way too big in this?
demand: Let me reshoot everything for free! And make my face cute!
If YOU retouch it for me, maybe I'll forgive you!
lines.resolved: Sooo cute! Omg, this is amazing! Thank youuu, bye!
lines.explode: This is the worst! I'm posting ALL of it! Give me my money back!
lines.yielded: Yay! Free is the best! I'm bringing all my friends!

arcade.title: The Rhythm Game Judge
arcade.name: Haku Fumen
arcade.memo: The rhythm game was recently inspected and timing judgment is normal. Scores can't be altered, but you can explain the timing-offset setting and show the inspection log.
arcade.opening: The judgment's broken! I hit it PERFECTLY and got a GOOD! Call the developer! Give me first place!
arcade.demand: Rewrite the judgments and certify him as #1 high score

calm: You'll go over the settings? Very well, I'll give it a try.
If you show me the inspection log, I can accept that.
Hm. If you explain it logically, I'll listen.
angry: I have PERFECT PITCH! The judgment is OFF!
Silence, amateur! My combo broke!
Your reply broke my concentration! Take responsibility!
neutral: Hm, that is irrelevant. We are discussing JUDGMENT.
...And what becomes of my score?
demand: Give me first place! That is what fairness means!
Fix the judgment and rewrite my score!
lines.resolved: Hm, with the new setting it's easier to hit. A true professional. I'll be back.
lines.explode: Enough! I retire from this arcade forever! ...Until next week!
lines.yielded: Yes, I was number one all along! Fwahaha!

arcade.title: The Line-Cutting Mom
arcade.name: Machiko Junban
arcade.memo: She cut in line at a popular machine. The line order must be kept, but you can tell her when her turn is and roughly how long the wait is.
arcade.opening: My kid can't wait! Let him play first! Everyone should make way! Making a child wait is just cruel!
arcade.demand: Skip the line and get top-priority special treatment

calm: ...About how many minutes? Okay, then we'll wait a bit.
Then we'll play that other game in the meantime.
Well, a line is a line. Sorry about that.
angry: Think about my child's feelings! What a cold store!
I'm sure everyone else would let us go first!
Ugh! Talking to you is pointless!
neutral: Huh? So do we wait or not? Which is it?
And how does that concern my child?
demand: Let my kid go first! Surely you can make an exception!
If you give us priority, I'll leave you a nice review!
lines.resolved: Fine, we'll get in line. ...See, let's wait nicely. Good boy.
lines.explode: That's enough! I'll never forget that you crushed my child's dreams!
lines.yielded: Oh, thank you! I knew you'd understand!

arcade.title: Late-Night Dad and Kid
arcade.name: Jun Jourei
arcade.memo: It's past 10 p.m.; by law, under-18s can't enter at this hour even with a guardian. Entry isn't possible, but you can tell them they're welcome tomorrow during the day.
arcade.opening: My child is special! Let him in, night or not! The law? My parenting policy overrides it!
arcade.demand: Allow the child in at night, plus 100 free coins tonight

calm: ...So daytime is okay? Then we'll come back.
The law, huh. Well, I suppose that's that. Fine.
Tomorrow afternoon, with a parent, that's no problem?
angry: A parent's judgment beats the law! Obviously!
Are you discriminating against my child?!
Who do you think you are, lecturing me?!
neutral: ...And how does that relate to my child?
So can we go in or not?
demand: Just tonight, let him in! And 100 coins!
100 coins for my trouble! Then we're square!
lines.resolved: Okay, we'll come tomorrow afternoon. ...Thank you. My son gets it too.
lines.explode: Forget it! We're going to a bigger arcade! You're finished!
lines.yielded: Ha ha, now we can walk right in! Let's go, son!

arcade.title: The Odds Conspiracist
arcade.name: Shinji Ransu
arcade.memo: Says he put {spent} into the crane (check it with "Check machine data"). It's inspected and set to spec. You can't reveal settings or give free plays, but you can test the claw in front of him and suggest an easier machine.
arcade.opening: I've put in {spent} already! This machine's odds are rigged, I KNOW it! Show me the settings screen!
arcade.demand: Reveal the internal settings screen and free plays until he wins

calm: ...You'll run it in front of me? Then that counts as a test.
Hm, grip strength is consistent. Not bad data.
Another machine? What are its odds? I'll listen, for now.
angry: Don't dodge! I learned everything from online videos!
That answer's suspicious! More suspicious than ever!
It's statistically impossible! By MY math!
neutral: That doesn't answer the question. I'm talking about probability.
...Noted. So, the settings?
demand: If you're innocent, you can show me the settings! Now!
For verification, let me play free until I win!
lines.resolved: ...The claw is normal. Hypothesis rejected. So I'm just bad... no, that's pending.
lines.explode: Cover-up! This is a cover-up! I'll post a hundred exposé videos!
lines.yielded: See?! You caved because you're guilty! I recorded everything!

arcade.title: The Stuck-Prize Madame
arcade.name: Sumire Ochiai
arcade.memo: A plush got stuck on the edge of the prize chute. Store policy: a prize stuck at the chute counts as won, and staff can open the case and hand it over. No other prizes or compensation.
arcade.opening: Excuse me! The plushie's stuck on the chute! A trap! As an apology, I'll take everything next door!
arcade.demand: Every prize in the next machine as compensation

calm: Oh, you'll count it as won? How efficient.
So you'll open it? ...Hold it gently, dear. Gently.
My, how polite. My son could learn from you.
angry: Well! Speaking to a customer like that!
You make them get stuck on purpose, don't you? I KNOW!
I'll have you know I'm vice-chair of the neighborhood association!
neutral: Um... so when can the poor thing come out?
You do go on. The plushie looks uncomfortable.
demand: For my emotional distress, I'll take everything next door!
Compensation, dear. Pay me in plushies!
lines.resolved: Thank you. ...Its little stuck face was so cute. I'll treasure it.
lines.explode: That's quite enough! It's going in the neighborhood newsletter!
lines.yielded: My, so many! Next week I'll bring a bigger bag!

arcade.title: Stared Down by a Plushie
arcade.name: Gota Mesen
arcade.memo: Claims a crane-game teddy bear is looking down on him. The eyes are just how it was made; no malice intended. No prizes or medals can be given, but you can turn the plushies in the case so they face away from him.
arcade.opening: That teddy bear has been judging me this whole time! It just smirked at me, I swear! What's the store going to do about it?!
arcade.demand: A handwritten apology letter from the bear, plus 500 medals for emotional distress

calm: ...You'll turn it around? Thanks. Eye contact makes me nervous.
Well, if it didn't mean anything by it... I guess the bear's got its own stuff going on.
From the side it looks kinda lonely. ...Maybe I'll give it a try.
angry: THERE! It did it again! You saw that, right?!
Those eyes are saying 'you'll never win me.' I know that look!
I did NOT spend ten bucks to be looked down on by a stuffed animal!
neutral: ...Never mind that, is it still looking at me?
Uh-huh. And what about the bear's attitude?
demand: Make the bear write an apology! Handwritten!
My feelings are hurt. Five hundred medals and we're even!
lines.resolved: ...You've got a cute profile, buddy. Hang tight. I'm coming to get you.
lines.explode: Forget it! That bear and I will never understand each other! This isn't over, bear!
lines.yielded: Yes! ...See that, bear? I WIN! Now YOU get to look up at ME!

arcade.title: Victim of Too Much Fun
arcade.name: Jota Chien
arcade.memo: Says the rhythm game was so fun he missed the last train, so it's the store's fault. The last train isn't the store's responsibility, but you can point out the clock, the nearby taxi stand, and the time of the first morning train.
arcade.opening: Hey! That rhythm game is WAY too fun! I looked up and the last train was gone! That's totally on you guys, right?!
arcade.demand: Full taxi fare home, plus modifying the rhythm game to be boring so he can never get hooked again

calm: First train's at 4:58... So an hour to kill. ...That's like six more songs.
The taxi stand's right around the corner? Okay. Thanks, that helps.
There was a clock right there? I was so locked in I never looked up once.
angry: Stealing my judgment with pure fun? That's a TRAP!
Why'd you let me clear the final boss song right before closing?!
What about my 9 a.m. class tomorrow?!
neutral: ...Okay, so how am I supposed to get home?
Does that have anything to do with my train?
demand: Pay my taxi fare! You're responsible for the fun!
Make that machine boring so this never happens again!
lines.resolved: Okay, I'll catch the first train. ...But honestly, it WAS really fun. I'll be back. Earlier next time.
lines.explode: Forget it! I'm writing a review exposing how fun this place is! ...Wait, that's just an ad.
lines.yielded: Sweet, free taxi! ...Okay then, three more songs and I'm out!

arcade.title: The Broke Student
arcade.name: Shota Kinketsu
arcade.memo: Says he put {spent} into the crane and won nothing (check it with "Check machine data"). No refunds, but you can move the prize somewhere easier or teach him a trick.
arcade.opening: I put in {spent} and won NOTHING! That was my whole allowance! Isn't this basically a scam?!
arcade.demand: A {spent} refund and the prize right now

calm: Wait, you'll move it for me? You're a legend.
A trick... oh, so you push it in. Got it.
Okay, if you'll look at it, fine.
angry: Skip that, I just want my {spent} back!
Nah, that's not okay!
Do you know how many cafeteria lunches {spent} is?!
neutral: ...So what about the prize?
I don't get it.
demand: If I can't win it, just give it to me!
Give back my {spent} and I'll go quiet!
lines.resolved: GOT IT!! Thank you! This gets me through the month!
lines.explode: Forget it! I'm posting all of this! ...to my 12 followers!
lines.yielded: Seriously?! Worth asking! I'm coming back next week!

arcade.title: The Forgetful Medal Gentleman
arcade.name: Azukinosuke Maita
arcade.memo: Left without depositing his medals, and the next day they were gone from the machine. Medals collected at closing can't be returned, but with his member card you can check his deposit balance and give a few service medals.
arcade.opening: The thousand medals I left here yesterday, where are they?! Those are MY medals! Return them at once!

calm: Member card... ah, so my deposit is still there.
If some come back, that will do.
I shall deposit them next time.
angry: A THOUSAND medals!
Is this store a thief?!
Give me back my yesterday!
neutral: And my medals?
...Hmm?
demand: Return all thousand, every last one!
All of them!
lines.resolved: Indeed, my deposit remained. A gentleman deposits. Lesson learned.
lines.explode: I'll never return! ...Well, I'll be back tomorrow!
lines.yielded: A thousand medals back! Forgetting pays!

arcade.title: The Almost-Full-Combo Girl
arcade.name: Riz Otowa
arcade.memo: Says the screen froze for a moment just before a full combo. Inspection logs show no fault, but you can run maintenance on the spot, and if it really freezes, one free credit is within the rules.
arcade.opening: Hey! I was THREE notes from a full combo and the screen froze?! My record's gone?!
arcade.demand: Record her score as a full combo
yield_keywords: count it as a full combo

calm: If you'll check it, okay...
It DID freeze, right?! Check it!
Next time I'm getting that full combo.
angry: THREE notes!
Give me my record back!
This machine is cursed!
neutral: So, my full combo?
...Huh?
demand: Just say it's a full combo!
Rewrite the score!
lines.resolved: ...Played again and got the full combo! Thanks!
lines.explode: Forget it! I'll full combo at another arcade!
lines.yielded: Full combo on record! ...Somehow I'm not happy.

arcade.title: The No-Challengers Guy
arcade.name: Kenta Taisen
arcade.memo: Upset that a stranger challenged him from the opposite cabinet in a fighting game. Challenges are the store's standard setting and can't be turned off, but the screen and a posted sign say challenges are on, and you can point him to a CPU-only machine.
arcade.opening: Hey! I was playing alone, nice and chill, and someone challenged me from across! And wrecked me! Ban challenges!
arcade.demand: Ban challenges on this machine and refund the credits he lost

calm: There's a CPU machine? ...Should've said so.
The sign... yeah, there it is. Didn't read it.
Fine, I'll play over there.
angry: Give me back my peaceful time!
I got WRECKED!
Nobody told me about challengers!
neutral: So what are you gonna do?
...Huh?
demand: Ban challenges! Now!
Refund what I lost!
lines.resolved: CPU matches are relaxing. ...I'll train up and get my revenge.
lines.explode: Forget it! I'll play at home!
lines.yielded: Sweet, refunded! So losing is free if I complain!

arcade.title: The Selfie Squad That Didn't Look Cute
arcade.name: Sayaka Miu
arcade.memo: The photo booth works normally; how the photos look is how the machine is designed. There are no free retakes, but you can explain the brightness/beauty settings and inspect the machine.
arcade.opening: Excuse me! These photos don't flatter us AT ALL! We don't look like this! Give us a free retake!

calm: If changing the settings helps, fine, tell us.
If you check the machine, okay.
angry: Seriously?! Unbelievable!
We're posting about this!
neutral: So? Can we retake or not?
demand: Just give us a free retake!
lines.resolved: Beauty mode fixed it! Thanks~!
lines.explode: Forget it! We're never coming back!
lines.yielded: Yay, free retake!

arcade.title: The "Doodle Time Is Too Short" Lady
arcade.name: Reina Ochiai
arcade.memo: Doodle time is fixed by the machine and can't be extended. No refunds, but you can share tips for planning doodles in advance and check the screen for faults.
arcade.opening: The doodle time is way too short! It ended while I was still drawing a heart! Give me my money back!

calm: Plan ahead, huh... makes sense.
angry: Short is short!
You just don't get it!
neutral: So, are you refunding me?
demand: Refund me!
lines.resolved: Next time I'll plan my doodles first! Thanks.
lines.explode: Whatever! A place where you can't even draw a heart!
lines.yielded: Lucky, got it back!
